heroSummary: Classes begin for all Adams 12 students on Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Sixth- and ninth-grade orientation is Monday, August 10. The district notes that sixth-grade orientation does not apply to K–8 schools. The last student day is Thursday, May 20, 2027. Families should also note the staff workdays that extend several holiday weekends and the winter closure.

definitions.description: Sixth- and ninth-grade orientation is August 10. The district notes that sixth-grade orientation does not apply to K–8 schools.
Each high school may replace the listed April 12 and May 3 staff workdays with another date in the same month.
Staff workdays extend the Labor Day and Presidents Day weekends and keep students out through January 4 after winter break.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school in Adams 12?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes begin for all Adams 12 students on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Do sixth- and ninth-grade students start earlier?
calendarFaqs.a: Sixth- and ninth-grade students attend orientation on Monday, August 10. The district notes that sixth-grade orientation does not apply to K–8 schools.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Adams 12 students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter break ends Friday, January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a staff workday, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Can Adams 12 high schools choose different staff workdays?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Each high school may replace the listed April 12 and May 3 staff workdays with another date in the same month.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the Adams 12 district calendar page and your school’s calendar. The district PDF is marked subject to revision, and individual high schools may move the April and May staff workdays.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: School starts one day earlier than it did in 2025–26, moving from August 12 to August 11.
The last student day is also one day earlier, moving from May 21 to May 20.
Each major break still begins on a Monday, but the dates fall one day earlier than in 2025–26.
